value.text: Suggest one museum to visit in Madrid.

Visit the **Museo Nacional del Prado**, one of the world's great art museums. It houses masterpieces by Velázquez (*Las Meninas*), Goya, and El Greco, and it's a short walk from Retiro Park. Booking a timed ticket online in advance helps you avoid long queues.
Suggest one park to visit in Madrid.

Visit **Retiro Park (Parque del Buen Retiro)**, Madrid's most iconic green space. You can rent a rowboat on the central lake, see the glass Crystal Palace, and stroll shaded promenades. It's central, free to enter, and easy to pair with a visit to the nearby Prado Museum.
